profile: Young researcher in mathematics and biostatistics, currently completing a Master of Science in Mathematical Sciences at the African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS South Africa, degree awarded by Stellenbosch University). Holder of two Master's degrees from the University of Abomey-Calavi (Biostatistics; Pure and Applied Mathematics) and a Bachelor's degree in Fundamental Mathematics. Strong experience in mathematical and epidemiological modeling, numerical analysis of PDEs, machine learning, and scientific programming (Python, R, Matlab, C/C++). Actively involved in training, mentorship, and scientific outreach across Africa (AIMS, Africa Scientifique, WAFIRA, Google DeepMind AI Research Foundations).
